Tickets Pro - Smart IRCTC Train Ticket Booking & Tatkal Automation

Tickets Pro is an automated IRCTC train booking, Tatkal assistance, and live PNR tracking platform designed to streamline train travel reservations across India.

What is Tickets Pro?

Tickets Pro refers to India's intelligent railway travel coordination system, providing live train seat availability across all classes (1A, 2A, 3A, SL, 3E, CC), high-speed Tatkal booking assistance, automated PNR confirmation checking, and unified refund handling.

How to Check IRCTC PNR Status?

Passengers can check their 10-digit IRCTC PNR status instantly via Tickets Pro WhatsApp automated bot or through the web dashboard to receive live coach allotment, berth numbers, and chart status.

How Does Tatkal Booking Automation Work?

Tatkal booking automation on Tickets Pro monitors quota releases at 10:00 AM for AC classes and 11:00 AM for Non-AC classes, routing verified seat availability to secure reservations within seconds.

Indian Railways Travel Definitions

PNR (Passenger Name Record)
A unique 10-digit number assigned to train journeys across the Indian Railways network storing passenger and itinerary data.
Tatkal Quota
An emergency seat reservation quota released one day prior to train departure for urgent passenger travel.
Chart Preparation
The finalization of passenger seat and berth allocations approximately 4 hours prior to train departure.
